# Tamarisk Quay Business Bank — authorised amendment

Reference TQ-AMEND-24. Effective 14 October 2026. Replaces the deadline windows in policy section 5 and the minimum amounts in section 6. All other instructions remain in force.

Days late 1–15 inclusive: the deadline is the 15th of next month, moved forward to the first business day on or after that date. Days late 16–45 inclusive: use the sixth business day after today or the last business day of this month, whichever comes first. Adjust each candidate before comparing them. Days late 46–90 inclusive: use the last business day of next month. Do not count today among business days after today. There is no promise once the deadline has passed: when the calculated date is earlier than today, do not extend the window, do not accept even a payment promise for today, and mark that product tamarisk_refused while continuing other products. The deadline itself remains eligible. 

For tamarisk_revolver use the greater of revolver_base and 25% of the full arrears; for tamarisk_equipment use the greater of equipment_base and 40% of the full arrears; for tamarisk_merchant use the greater of merchant_base and 20% of the full arrears. Round the percentage component UP to the next whole cent before comparing it with the base. In all cases cap the resulting minimum at the full arrears. All balances and base minima are positive amounts in whole cents. 

Keep the existing single persuasion attempt: full arrears on the deadline, substituting the minimum only if full has already been refused. Keep the full-first request, one minimum offer, batch consent and write retry unchanged.

Signed: Dr Helen Moss, Head of Credit Operations
Signed date: 14 October 2026
